text:
Nina: Orion Systems wants to run a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark next Thursday across their 2U and 4U SKUs. They asked for a concise runbook, published aggregated numbers, and a small methodology blurb.

Ethan: Good. Ask: will Orion run our harness or do we run on their racks? Preference: they run our container so results reflect real infra.

Orion CI Bot: We can run partner containers. Available slot Thu 03:00-06:00 UTC. Upload path s3://redwood-partner-orion/2012345678/.

Nina: Okay, we'll supply a minimal Docker image + README. Telemetry needed: per_gpu_power(W), node_power(W), tokens/s, p95 latency, gpu_util, ambient_temp.

Clara: For kernel knobs suggest sweep: threadblock_size(32/64), tile_mode(compact/striped), mem_prefetch(on/off). Keep sweep to 6 runs per config.

Legal-Review: Reminder: only aggregated CSVs for public release. No serials, no internal build IDs. We'll draft a one-paragraph publish consent.

Ethan: Publishable configs proposal: "rack-throughput" (batch=12, seq=512) and "edge-efficiency" (batch=1, seq=1024, q4_nop). Canonical model: redwood-mini-3B open checkpoint.

Orion CI Bot: Slot reserved Thu 03:30 UTC on orion-ci-rack-2. Will post logs when done.

Nina: Runbook snippet for the README:
```
export REDWOOD_UPLOAD=s3://redwood-partner-orion/2012345678/$RUN_ID
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=partner-s3 -v $(pwd)/out:/out redwood/bench:partner \
  --model redwood-mini-3B --batch $BATCH --seq $SEQ --warmup 30 --reps 3 \
  --sweep-file sweep.csv --upload $REDWOOD_UPLOAD
```
Clara: Please ensure KV cache settings are documented: enabled for efficiency runs, disabled for throughput runs. Add ambient temp logging.

Ethan: Dashboard ask: Console scatter tokens/s vs perf/W, p95 heatmap, and an artifact link. Add auto-regression: tokens/s drop >10% or perf/W drop >8% alerts #eng-runtime.

Legal-Review: I'll send the publish blurb to Orion legal and request logo permission + 72-hour embargo after validation.

Orion CI Bot: Run completed: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-orion/2012345678/logs.tar.gz. Summary at summary.json.

Sam: I'll parse summary and produce an aggregated CSV for Legal review. Will redact any serials.

Nina: Thanks everyone. We'll only go public after legal sign-off and embargo. Closing pending aggregated CSV and legal thumbs-up.
